locations.title: Astra Malorum Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, get the [LGM-1 Wonder Weapon from the easter egg](#loc=504727)
- Then, on or after round 10, follow [O.S.C.A.R.](#loc=503932) without alerting him, which will cause him to play a tape containing three planets.
- Each planet corresponds to a number, dependent on how far it is in the solar system away from the sun.
   - Mercury = 1, Venus = 2, Earth = 3, Mars = 4, Jupiter = 5, Saturn = 6, Uranus = 7, Neptune = 8
- Input the code into the [Three-Digit Machine](#loc=504765) to drop a lift in the room.
- On the lift, loot the [Cryo Chamber Key](#loc=504766) from the dead zombie and head back to the museum.
- Grab the [Rock Saw](#loc=504767) in a display case in the south-west part of the room.
- Head to the [Cryo Chamber](#loc=504768) inside the Machina Astralis and use the key to open it.
- Use the rock saw to remove the brain from the frozen body.
- Bring the brain to the [Brain in a Jar](#loc=504769) and replace the brain with the frozen one.
- Defend the brain from incoming zombies until the brain is ready.
- Bring the brain to the [Brain Machine](#loc=504770) in the large dome.
- Head to and use the telescope next to the [Harmonic Oculus](#loc=503920) and set it to look at Mars.
- Enter the coordinates of Mars into the [Four-Digit Machine](#loc=504771).
- Head down to the Brain Machine and take note of the book titles being displayed on the screen.
- In the Archive of Orbis, turn the statues in the room as many times as the book names show up on the screen.
   - Turn only the statue on the same level and wall as the book.
   - For instance, if a bookshelf contains a book from the screen, turn the statue once. If a bookshelf contains two books from the screen, turn the statue twice.
- Once all statues are turned properly, head up the ladder and grab the model of Neptune.
- Head back into the dome room and above the brain machine, place the Neptune model in the solar system hanging from the ceiling.
- Then, you'll need to align each planet by shooting them and putting them in a specific quadrant around the sun hanging from the ceiling. The direction for the three required can be found on three notes around the map:
   - [Planet Note](#loc=504772)
   - [Planet Note](#loc=504773)
   - [Planet Note](#loc=504774)
- Activate the brain machine to cause the portal to start opening in the center of the room.
- Shoot the drones coming off of the O.S.C.A.R. so they don't attack the portal until the portal is done and you'll be teleported to Mars.
- Pick up the brain in the center of the area and place it in the [Electricity Machine](#loc=504779).
- Interact with the machine and look outside the map to the east to see four coils on top of pillars.
- Shoot the coils in a specific order:
   - Far Right
   - Far Left
   - Close Right
   - Close Left
- Then, shoot the coil above the electricity machine.
- A [flying eye](#loc=504996) will enter the area. Jump up and grab the eye out of the sky and place it in the [Eye Machine](#loc=504780).
- Next, head back to the Harmonic Oculus and interact with the organ.
- Four symbols will be displayed with a fifth one hidden.
- Around the arena, shoot the five antennas on top of the pillars with the LGM-1 in order that it appeared on the screen, with the hidden one being whichever pillar symbol you didn't see.
   - [Symbol Pillar](#loc=504785)
   - [Symbol Pillar](#loc=504784)
   - [Symbol Pillar](#loc=504783)
   - [Symbol Pillar](#loc=504782)
   - [Symbol Pillar](#loc=504781)
- After shooting all five, interact with each one in the same order.
- Interact with the electricity machine one last time to spawn the final boss.

locations.title: LGM-1 Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- There are four items needed before you can acquire the wonder weapon:
   - The [Damaged Drone](#loc=503931), dropped by destroying one of [O.S.C.A.R.](#loc=503932)'s defensive drones
   - The [Aberrant Wiring](#loc=504728), dropped after shooting a random blinking lamp found throughout the map
   - The [Absolute Zero Shards](#loc=504729), dropped after shooting three aether crystals using a cryofreeze weapon
   - The [Car Battery](#loc=504730), dropped by Ol' Tessie after shooting its hood with a Pack-a-Punched weapon
- After acquiring all four items, O.S.C.A.R. will need to be led to and killed in three different places:
   - After completing the [Telescope Easter Egg](#loc=504738), set the telescope to look at the sun, causing a sun laser to shoot in the center of the room. Lead O.S.C.A.R. into the laser to instantly die.
   - Lead O.S.C.A.R. to the [Stellar Dissector](#loc=503882) trap and activate it. Keep O.S.C.A.R. in the room while the bar fills up, destroying his drones and time goes on. Eventually, he'll be overcharged and destroyed.
   - Lead O.S.C.A.R. to the [Rocket](#loc=504764) in the center of the museum and interact with the display to turn it on. Hold O.S.C.A.R. in front of the rocket when the countdown goes off to destroy him.
- After he is killed by the last trap, he will drop the LGM-1 wonder weapon.

locations.title: Telescope Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- To use the telescope after turning on the power, you'll need to shoot eight spinning machines around the telescope in quick succession.
- These can be found around the room and even under the [Harmonic Oculus](#loc=503920).
- After all of them are shot, the telescope can be used and accessed next to the Harmonic Oculus.

locations.title: Shiny Trinket Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map, in a random zombie window, there will be a pair of glowing eyes
- Throw a shiny trinket through the window and something will eat it
   - Shiny trinkets can be gathered by killing O.S.C.A.R.
- Find the eyes again two more times and a friendly ravager will appear

locations.title: Alpha Omega Records Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map are three records that'll need to be collected:
   - [Record](#loc=505010)
   - [Record](#loc=505011)
   - [Record](#loc=505012)
- After collecting all three, interact with the [Record Player](#loc=505013) for a song to play out of it

locations.title: Skulls Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, pack-a-punch a gun and head to five locations throughout the map
- Shoot and pick up the skull sitting at each location with the pack-a-punched gun:
   - [Skull](#loc=505017)
   - [Skull](#loc=505021)
   - [Skull](#loc=505020)
   - [Skull](#loc=505019)
   - [Skull](#loc=505018)
- After acquiring all five skulls, head to the [Skull Table](#loc=505023) and place down each skull
- Memorize the order for which the skulls light up and float
- Shoot the skulls in that order to receive a free random perk

locations.title: Magic Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the two map, there are three headphones that need to be interacted with to hear a secret song:
   - [Headphones](#loc=505008)
   - [Headphones](#loc=505009)
   - [Headphones](#loc=505029)

locations.title: Echoes of the Damned Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- As Nikolai, head to the [Ammo Cache](#loc=503888) in Abyssal Rim and throw a molotov on the ground.
- Follow the footsteps and keep throwing molotovs to reach a cave.
- Interact with the [Figurine](#loc=940490) in front to start the cutscenes.

locations.title: Wisp Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside one of the lanterns in the first few areas is a wisp.
- Aim at the lantern to grab the wisp then throw it and retrieve it into each lantern:
   - [Lantern](#loc=940524)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940525)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940513)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940516)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940517)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940509)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940519)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940523)
   - [Lantern](#loc=940522)
- After placing it into the last one, keep it there and flip rounds.
- Every lantern will now carry an upgraded wisp.
- Starting at Round 16, a rocket will float past Saturn in the sky. Throw a wisp at the rocket to receive a Ray Gun.

locations.title: Twins Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- On a dog round, head to Museum Infinitum and interact with the [Display Cabinet](#loc=940537).
- For the next four rounds, find one of the display cases that is playing noise and interact with it.
- After the four rounds, the twins can be found around the map every other round and will drop loot when found.

locations.title: Slow Time Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the map are 5 clocks:
   - [Clock](#loc=940499)
   - [Clock](#loc=940521)
   - [Clock](#loc=940502)
   - [Clock](#loc=940501)
   - [Clock](#loc=940532)
- Melee them in quick succession to slow down zombies for 60 seconds. This can be done every round.

locations.title: Pareidolia Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Once making it to Mars, activate the portal back to the regular map first.
- Then, stare at the [Head Statue](#loc=940569) in ADS for the song to play.

locations.title: DG-2 Turret Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to Abyssal Rim next to the [Wisp Tea](#loc=503889) perk machine.
- Throw an explosive at the [Floating Rock](#loc=957183) to split it apart, then wall jump off of it to start floating through space.
- While floating, grab the [DG-2 Turret Barrel](#loc=957184) floating in the middle of space.
- Head back to Ol' Tessie to install the DG-2 Turret on top.

locations.title: Astra Malorum Super Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, acquire the [LGM-1](#loc=504995) from the [LGM-1 Easter Egg](#loc=504727).
- Then, head around the map and find a Floating Toy Box just outside the map and use an explosive on it to move it in order:
   1. [Floating Toy Box](#loc=957178)
   2. [Floating Toy Box](#loc=957180)
- The [Floating Toy Box](#loc=957181) will move to just outside the Crash Site. Use a LT53 Kazimir to pull it down to the ground.
- Next, complete the [DG-2 Turret Easter Egg](#loc=957177) to acquire the [DG-2 Turret Barrel](#loc=957184) and place it on the back of Tessie.
- Bring O.S.C.A.R. near Tessie and kill him, with the final blow being from the DG-2, opening the [Toy Box](#loc=957182).
- Next, slow down the map using the [Slow Time Easter Egg](#loc=940542).
- While time is slowed, head to the [Harmonic Oculus](#loc=503920) and look through the telescope.
- Find the UFO flying around the radar and hover over it to stop it.
- Progress through the [Astra Malorum Main Easter Egg](#loc=504726) and reach Mars, as well as grabbing and placing the [Ascendent Eye](#loc=504996) and using the LGM-1 on the Symbol Pillars.
- Now, there are two Dials on the side of the map:
   - [Dial](#loc=957185)
   - [Dial](#loc=957186)
- Throw Shock Charges onto both of them to call in the UFO.
- Head back to the main map and acquire four wisps from the [Wisp Easter Egg](#loc=940535).
- Head back to Mars and, one at a time, shoot a wisp at the [Floating Items](#loc=957187) in the corner.
- Each time, the UFO will grab the item and place down loot.
- After the fourth object has been grabbed, the UFO will drop an Alien toy.
- Bring the Alien toy to the Toy Box and receive the Caltheris toy, then Exfil.
